board: Seeed Studio Grove - Sound Sensor v1.6 (SKU 101020023, LM358, Grove pins SIG, NC, VCC, GND)
reason: Check passed on the ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test (PP=2.0V) and circuit board all passed. SIG is modelled as an AC-coupled swing, as in Seeed's v1.6 schematic (two x11 LM358 stages, then 220 nF in series to SIG). The driver measures peak-to-peak, and the 1.65 V centre assumes the recommended 2 x 100k bias divider; the sim uses a sine, while the real board gives a half-wave signal with the same peak-to-peak.
breakoutPinoutSource: Seeed Grove - Sound Sensor v1.6 schematic, J1 pin1 SIG, pin2 unconnected, pin3 VCC, pin4 GND (https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Grove_Sound_Sensor/res/Grove%20-%20Sound%20Sensor%20v1.6%20Schematic.pdf) and https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/Grove-Sound_Sensor/
